lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Approximately five to six horizontal rows of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect horizontal rows, with primary high-intensity blobs functioning as anchor nodes at these intersections.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal features on the upper lateral flank exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient, running parallel to the longitudinal axis of the body.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately three to four high-luminance blobs localized within the ventral half of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense, stochastic distribution of small-diameter high-luminance pixel clusters on the cephalic region, transitioning to the organized grid pattern posterior to the gills.
